== Dated PC image versions ==
The exact Holotable sources for this family date to 2018-07-08, 2023-01-22. These images retain the same game text while their published orientation, frame or artwork changes. Original bytes and documented unscaled crops accompany each article. Historical pages do not invent playable IDs. Both face lores explicitly describe a bounty hunter. The PC metadata now uses that printed trait rather than the previously unsupported Black Sun agent tag. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 13 November 2026 (UTC).

== June 2017 lower-source chronology ==
Actual [[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf]] page 3 prints the composed lower cutout marked E. The cover directs using it with the original physical card; only uncovered title, uniqueness, destiny, literal lore and category/set icons follow [[:File:ANH-D-danzborin-hires.webp]]. The source order is June 2017 partial, first located 2018 full marked E, then later full marked D-E1. Cover/repository dates are edition or first-located evidence, not established original publication days. The actual 1998 entry, page 45, predates these PC images. Current 2023 rules and historical document explanations are kept distinct; the comparison catalogs published source states without a gameplay implementation claim. Existing executable bindings remain 2_85 on the latest full PC face. No new historical blueprint is invented. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 14 November 2026 (UTC).
